newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers softer amid average enquries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers softer amid average enquries.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Friday were quoted softer, tracking overnight published quotes but prices may rise later if cargo levels continue to stay supported, brokers said.
Bunker 380-cst prices were quoted at $120-$123 per tonne with 180-cst at $124-$128 per tonne. Bunker 180 cst was quoted at $126-$128, 380 cst at $120-$124 on Thursday.
MDO prices were indicated between $210-$220 and gas oil steady at $230-$235. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
